dpopPrerequisite.reason: The upstream validator omits DPoP from token requests even when the issuer advertises it. The bearer profile supplies accepted controls for all eight checks without disabling any DPoP requirement on the other profiles.

notes: The pinned draft 1.0 kit (13 November, upstream bb98332) against the mock serving 1.0 alone. Its catalogue and findings are the 0.4 kit's: the kit's validator has no check for protocol descriptions, Pushed Authorization Requests, prompt=consent or the DPoP key at refresh; it makes assertion.ps384 a MUST, which still waits on the same DPoP prerequisite (spec/company-kit-2026-11-13/README.md). These are reviewed observations, not rewritten upstream verdicts: any new failure, warning or skip, any disappeared reviewed finding, or any failed bearer control fails the review check. Mock skips: discovery.supported-versions and discovery.versions-same-company, because the reviewed run serves one version (docs/readings.md#v04-version-missing). The issuerless profile adds the OAuth checks that need an issuer.
